shared: Create exactly ONE finished weapon concept illustration for a first-person roguelite shooter. Show one complete handheld weapon in a readable three-quarter side view, muzzle pointing right, full silhouette inside the frame. The weapon fires miniature black-hole projectiles that pull enemies inward. A tiny stable singularity is visibly contained inside the emitter: an absolutely black spherical centre, one thin restrained violet accretion crescent and only a few subtle inward-bending light streaks. It must read as a physical weapon with a grip, trigger area, body and ammunition mechanism, not as a magic staff. Broad chunky shapes, clear mechanical assembly and practical first-person proportions. Neutral light warm-grey seamless background, even neutral lighting, no dramatic scene. No hands, no character, no stand, no ground, no cast shadow, no separate projectile, no extra objects, no labels, no text, no logo, no border, no collage, no multiple views. Concept art only; glow and distortion are restrained so the solid weapon remains readable.

designs.brief: A compact heavy containment launcher built around a thick octagonal armoured receiver. At the front, four massive squared containment jaws form a short open cage around the visible black singularity; the jaws are wide enough to model and do not taper into needles. A removable rectangular void-cell magazine sits behind and below the receiver. Strong boxy silhouette, broad bevels, a rear pistol grip and a short shoulder stock. Dominant charcoal-violet metal and dark blue-black steel, with aged copper locking bands and two small warm ivory ceramic armour blocks. Restrained violet light only in the singularity crescent and three deep containment grooves. Defensive, engineered, reliable, iconic octagonal muzzle.

An arcane astronomical projector inspired by a chunky armillary sphere, rebuilt as a practical shoulder-fired weapon. Three thick staggered orbital rings surround the visible black singularity at the front, each ring broad and faceted with simple measuring notches rather than delicate filigree. The rings connect to a solid indigo receiver, a winding side drum, a curved pistol grip and a compact stock. Long horizontal silhouette with an open circular front. Dominant deep indigo and midnight steel, antique gold ring edges, very small muted purple enamel panels. Restrained violet-cyan glow only in the accretion crescent and a few ring grooves. Precision instrument meets catastrophic weapon, unmistakable concentric-ring silhouette.

A brutal heavy void cannon shaped like a restrained demon maw without becoming an organic creature. Two huge angular obsidian jaw plates surround a circular front chamber containing the visible black singularity. Six thick ash-ivory mineral fangs act as mechanical locking claws, three above and three below, with large simple shapes. A bulky rear breech, burgundy wrapped pistol grip and short stock keep it visibly man-made and usable. Dominant blue-black obsidian and charcoal metal, ash-ivory mineral clamps, restrained oxblood-red wrapping. A narrow violet accretion crescent is the only bright light. Aggressive asymmetric silhouette, heavy and immediate, no gore, no eyes, no saliva, no dense spikes.

A long sleek precision void-lance rifle with an elongated split-fork emitter. Two substantial parallel prongs extend forward and bend slightly inward around the visible black singularity, leaving a clear gap between them. A long dark lacquered receiver, slim stock, comfortable pistol grip and a small cylindrical vacuum magazine under the rear body. Elegant horizontal silhouette, long but still chunky enough for a stylized game model. Dominant near-black lacquered wood and deep navy steel, pale brushed brass structural rails, small desaturated celadon enamel insets. Restrained cold violet light only in the accretion crescent and two straight barrel channels. Controlled, precise, dangerous, clearly distinct from a conventional bullet rifle.
